description:
Are you a passionate, talented software junky ready to tackle some of the largest supply chain challenges in the world? Are you looking to join a world class team that creates innovative software solutions to get products to your front door at blazing speed? If so, we’re looking for you! As a software engineer at Dematic, you will tackle some of the most challenging and rewarding logistics projects in the world. You will work alongside other best-in-class professionals to implement large, complex integrated business solutions for some of the world’s leading brands! 

Sound like you? Come join us and get ready to make a difference! 
 We offer: 
 What We Offer: 

 Career Development 
 Competitive Compensation and Benefits 
 Pay Transparency 
 Global Opportunities 
 
 Learn More Here:  
 https://www.dematic.com/en-us/about/careers/what-we-offer/  

 Dematic provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.   

 This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation and training.   

 The base pay range for this role is estimated to be $82,000 - $166,000 at the time of posting. Final compensation will be determined by various factors such as work location, education, experience, knowledge, and skills. 
 
 Tasks and Qualifications: 
 Skilled software developer to create software application functionality and configuration using commercial development tools and applications based on customer and / or project performance, design, and testing requirements. 
 
 What You Will do in This Role: 

 Create elegant solutions for some of the most complex material handling and logistics projects in the world. 
 Deliver large, impactful, and meaningful enterprise projects while working in a small, nimble, and flexible start-up environment. 
 Collaborate with highly cross-functional, Agile teams to build out new customer features and functionality. 
 Develop high-quality code and unit tests. 
 Play a critical role in system design, architecture, and execution. 
 Works independently and within a team with little required coaching. 
 Coaches and mentors lesser experienced developers. 
 Supports and improve internal processes to make code deployment easier, faster and more consistent. 
 Ability to break down tasks into work packets. 
 Collaborate to troubleshoot and solve complex problems across integrated software and mechatronic systems. 
 Continually improving skill level through certifications and training. 
 Travel across North America to customer sites to validate system functionality and testing (approximately 20%).    
 
 What We are Looking For: 

 BS - Computer Science (or other Engineering Degree) 
 5+ Years software development experience. 
 1+ Years automation or material handling industry experience. 
 Advanced knowledge in minimum of 2 object-oriented languages, including Java EE 
 Proficient in at least 1 other language. 
 Intermediate knowledge of at least 2 operating systems. 
 2 industry standard certifications. 
 
 Location & Authorization:  This is a hybrid role requiring proximity to one of our U.S. offices (Grand Rapids, MI; Atlanta, GA, Milwaukee WI, Plano TX). Applicants must be authorized to work in the U.S. without the need for current or future sponsorship.

 #LI-DP1
